description: Where does a link really go? Follows a URL (short links like bit.ly, tracking links, QR code links) hop by hop without a browser: every redirect with status code (301/302/307/308/meta refresh), final URL and page title, plus warning signs (ends on a different site, domain registered < 30 days ago, punycode look-alike name, bare IP, no HTTPS, loops, long chains) and a copy of the final URL with tracking parameters removed. Does not scan pages for malware. Max 10 hops; cached 60 s.

url.description: The link to check, e.g. bit.ly/abc123 or https://example.com/page

name: trace_redirects
